camel_example: aliyun iot QuerySpeechPushJob --region cn-hangzhou --PageId 1 --StatusList.1 'example-string' --IotInstanceId 'iot-06000000' --PageSize 20 --JobCode tBUm00000000000000000000000QPGT --ProjectCode 0Ykj000000000000000000000000Av0I --PushMode ALL
description_en: Queries the list of corpus push tasks for a specified project
description_zh: 查询指定项目的语料推送任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-speech-push-job --iot-instance-id iot-06000000 --project-code 0Ykj000000000000000000000000Av0I --push-mode ALL --job-code tBUm00000000000000000000000QPGT --page-size 20 --page-id 1 --status-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySpeechPushJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice>
If the public instance does not have an ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的实例ID。
<notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the Project Management console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过项目管理控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID
parameters.name: project_code

parameters.help_en:
The mode of the push task. If this parameter is not specified, all modes are queried.

SINGLE_DEVICE: single-device push.
ALL: full-device push.
GROUP_DEVICE: group-device push
parameters.help_zh:
推送任务的模式，不传则查询所有模式。

SINGLE_DEVICE：单设备推送。
ALL：全量设备推送。
GROUP_DEVICE：分组设备推送
parameters.name: push_mode

parameters.help_en: The push task ID. The Data field returned after a successful call to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217573.html is the push task ID
parameters.help_zh: 推送任务ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217573.html成功后返回的**Data**字段为推送任务ID
parameters.name: job_code

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页返回数据的最大条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.name: page_id

parameters.help_en:
The status list of corpus push tasks to query. If this parameter is not specified, all statuses are queried.

RUNNING: running.
CANCEL: canceled.
SUCCESS: succeeded.
TIMEOUT: timed out
parameters.help_zh:
查询语料推送任务的状态列表，不传则查询所有状态。

RUNNING：运行中。
CANCEL：取消。
SUCCESS：成功。
TIMEOUT：超时
parameters.name: status_list
